title: A handle creates at a frozen line exactly when its single points leave the line's claims
subject: What each face around the attachment point reads, and what decides whether an opened handle creates there
conclusion: Around an attachment point the own arc between two ports is barred exactly when they disagree, and a frozen line claims an own arc from one port pattern but an opposite face from two. A handle creates at a frozen line exactly when a pair of its points freezes it and neither point alone excludes either claim (one direction proved, one computed), so the Fano plane, whose single points remove one pattern per other class, never uses own arcs.
